channel.title: Local News Wire Broadcast Feed
channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: Brandon town leaders are eyeing a two percent tax increase for the next budget. Town employees could see raises up to five percent, while police get a three percent plus two percent step raise. Rising costs for healthcare and fuel are major budget drivers.

Rutland City Recreation Committee approved a two point eight million dollar budget. Fuel costs were estimated at four dollars per gallon, though some worry this is low. The department brought in over seven hundred thousand dollars in revenue last year.

Rutland City will not defend a zoning appeal involving a downtown business. The Development Review Board voided a permit for a short-term rental and event space. The business owner has appealed to Vermont Environmental Court.

Rutland Free Library faces at least fifteen million dollars in building repairs. This year, repairs have already gone over budget by more than one hundred ten thousand dollars. Major upcoming fixes include windows, ADA upgrades, and a possibly leaking fuel tank.
